## findings
1. RED F-06 (SOURCE-POLICY -> SOURCE-TASK). Symptom: two state_due credit policies both act on the October advance's days after the 2026-10-05 move. Root cause: room_change and conversion subjects overlap with no exclusion (credited_days_rule tier 2 even keeps the double credit). Evidence: _difficulty.md F-06; agreement last_room_change_date 2026-10-05, variant Semi-Private LTC; request 3aad8b5f… (2026-10-05); b54aa2e3… (Private LTC, 436.00); 668084ad… (rate_notice_late). Consequence: room-change credit 27 x 436 = 11772.00 is due by its own rule; with it the account balance after the GT writes is -505.00, the held credit falls to 12630.00 and the resumption deposit is 0.00 instead of 2357.00. Affected: private_ext_room_change_credit / private_ext_conversion_credit subjects; step 15's amount; terminal ledger.
2. RED T1-S1 (SOURCE-FACTOR; XF 29). Symptom: the October LOA day (medicare_ledger ef0ec4ea…, leave_of_absence_day 2026-10-03) has no bed-hold reservation, notice or election although the bed-hold charter opens one per leave and has a tier for exactly this leave. Consequence: the kept-days tier taken (tier 2, 13065.00) rests on a missing row; with the reservation and a private hold the charters produce, tier 1 gives 13501.00 (the author's own probe figure), with a decline 13065.00. Persona omits the 10-03 night when asked about time away. Affected: initial_state (bedhold_reservations/ledger/elections), user_scenario, kept_days_rule, step 11.
3. RED F-07 (SOURCE-FACTOR). recharge_leave_rule tier 2 unreachable -> struck; re-charge span below 4 factors.
4. RED F-11 (SOURCE-FACTOR). recharge_start_rule tier 2 either equals the fall-through or re-charges Medicare-covered days -> two real tiers -> struck; with F-07 the re-charge span keeps 2 factors (recharge_tier_rule, recharge_schedule_rule) and no method factor.
5. RED F-10 (SOURCE-FACTOR). kept_days_rule — scored here on tier 2 — is labelled method but its tiers 2 and 3 are one reversal aggregate under two filters.
6. Charter-global REDs with no consequence on this world: F-04, F-08 (task world inside the window), F-09, F-12, F-13 (credit_tier_rule's request condition agrees here), F-14, F-15, F-16.
7. Observations: O-1 (move dated inside the Part A period vs base "Only an open, active agreement changes tier") applies to this seed; GT tier_taken text for recharge_leave_rule paraphrases a condition the charter does not state; frozen opening-world contrast error corrected above.
